breakdown.description: The concentrated top load is replaced by a distributed traction patch
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly applies the -5 kN load as a uniform traction distributed over the top notch edge from (0.3,0.5) to (0.5,0.5), computing traction as -5000/0.2 = 25000 Pa and applying it via a surface integral ds. This repeats the exact error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires using PointSource on the appropriate displacement component at point (0.4, 0.5) instead of smearing the load over an edge.
